What is SaaSBase and how does it compare: What is SaaSBase and how does it compare to Coolify or Dokploy?
SaaSBase is an open-source, self-hosted: SaaSBase is an open-source, self-hosted PaaS and BaaS deployer. While general PaaS tools focus on general web apps, SaaSBase provides deep, specialized automation for modern Backend-as-a-Service platforms (especially Supabase, PocketBase, and Appwrite), including automated database clustering, connection pooling, cloud migration, and offsite disaster recovery.
What VPS providers and operating systems: What VPS providers and operating systems are supported?

You can connect servers from Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Vultr, AWS, OVH, or your own on-premise hardware via SSH.

How does SaaSBase secure secrets, keys,: How does SaaSBase secure secrets, keys, and backups?
All secrets, passwords, and SSH keys are: All secrets, passwords, and SSH keys are stored in a versioned format (v2:) using HKDF key derivation. Database backups are encrypted with AES-256-CBC and streamed offsite to Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, or Backblaze B2. Furthermore, a one-time SETUP_TOKEN prevents unauthorized instance takeovers during initialization.

Yes! SaaSBase natively integrates Cloudf: Yes! SaaSBase natively integrates Cloudflare Tunnel (Zero Trust). You can publish your applications and dashboards to the web using an outbound tunnel connector token, keeping ports 80 and 443 closed on your VPS firewall.
How does zero-downtime server migration: How does zero-downtime server migration work?
When moving an app to another server, Sa: When moving an app to another server, SaaSBase takes an atomic backup, streams it via S3/R2 storage, restores and health-checks all containers on the target machine, updates DNS records, and only removes source resources once health is 100% verified. If any step fails, it automatically rolls back.
